hints.title: Circular Step Equivalence
hints.text: Every subarray of length k has equal sum if and only if arr[i] equals arr[(i + k) % n] for all i.

hints.title: Greatest Common Divisor Grouping
hints.text: In a circular array of size n with step k, indices partition into g = gcd(n, k) independent cyclic components.

hints.title: Median Value Minimization
hints.text: To minimize the sum of absolute changes for numbers in each group, set all elements in that group to the group median.

hints.title: GCD Group Median Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def makeSubKSumEqual(self, arr: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        import math
        n = len(arr)
        g = math.gcd(n, k)
        ans = 0
        for i in range(g):
            group = [arr[j] for j in range(i, n, g)]
            group.sort()
            med = group[len(group) // 2]
            ans += sum(abs(x - med) for x in group)
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Grouping elements by index modulo gcd(n, k) and sorting each group to find the median.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating operations without recognizing circular gcd component independence is intractable.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies cyclic period gcd(n, k) and applies median L1 norm minimization.
